narrative.details:
Whatever this is all about, adventurer, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 27 to 32, 8,550 XP in all.

quests.name: Uncovering the Past
quests.objectiveText: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.

quests.name: Understanding Our Present
quests.objectiveText: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.

quests.name: Gleaning Our Future
quests.objectiveText: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.

quests.name: For Further Study
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
